title: Root transition of the ordinary vector trace on a single frame
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, n a natural number, and A the finite coefficient ring finiteTateCoefficient ell E n of [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates]. Let S be a Noetherian scheme on which ell is invertible, F a finite locally free module of rank d, and pi the corresponding vector bundle projection. Let r <= s with ell^(r+1) and ell^(s+1) annihilating A. Let B_sr be the normalized root-power isomorphism baseExponentComparison from the degree-d shifted finite Tate coefficient at exponent s to that at exponent r. Choose any normalized ordinary twist transports tr, ts and projective-line data Dr, Ds, as in [def-amb-p1-trace]. For each open immersion u:V -> S and each trivialization e of F on V, let a_r and a_s be the actual ordinary local traces vectorIntegrationLocalTrace of [def-amb-vector-integration] using these data. Then u^* Rpi_!(pi^* B_sr) followed by a_r equals a_s. This is an equality on one frame before global gluing and before any comparison between sites. It includes rank zero, empty frames, equal exponents and ramified coefficient quotients.

proof.text: Apply the ordered coefficient root-transition pullback square along V->S. Naturality of the inverse-image composition comparison for the inverse frame, followed by cancellation of the coefficient descents, gives the chart-coefficient square. The private generic coefficient_square proves the categorical cancellation.

Apply naturality of the actual rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap to the pulled-back base transition. Naturality of the composite bounded-below compact-support comparison moves the resulting ordered-tower coefficient transition through its inverse; this is proved in compact_comparison_naturality directly from its three natural isomorphisms.

Expand vectorIntegrationLocalTrace. Rewrite with the exchange and coefficient squares, functoriality of compact support, and inverse-comparison naturality. The ordered affine counit exponent equation finishes the composite equality. No global gluing, finite-type field setting or pro-etale trace is used. The private generic paste_trace_square carries out this composition without unfolding the geometric definitions inside a rewrite tactic.

theorem vectorIntegrationLocalTrace_exponentTransition
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ) (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (r s : ℕ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (hs : ((l ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (tr : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
      (l ^ (r + 1)) hr)
    (Dr : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
        (l ^ (r + 1)) hr tr T hT)
    (ts : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
      (l ^ (s + 1)) hs)
    (Ds : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit ((l ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
        (l ^ (s + 1)) hs ts T hT)
    (V : S.Opens) (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V) :
    (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) V.ι).map
      ((Etale.vectorBundlePurityLower (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) S d F).map
        ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n)
          (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)).map
            (baseExponentComparison l E n S hS r s hrs hr hs d).hom)) ≫
      Etale.vectorIntegrationLocalTrace (l ^ (r + 1))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) _ hr tr Dr S
        (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (r + 1)) d F V e =
      Etale.vectorIntegrationLocalTrace (l ^ (s + 1))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) _ hs ts Ds S
        (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (s + 1)) d F V e
